source.author: verg
source.text: Ille meos, primus qui me sibi iunxit, amores abstulit; ille habeat secum servetque sepulchro.
source.text_original: Ille meos, primus qui me sibi iunxit, amores / abstulit; ille habeat secum servetque sepulchro.'
source.text_english: He who first joined me to himself took away my loves; let him keep them with him and guard them in his tomb.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: audi, quid ex persona uiduae continentis ethnicus poeta decantet: ille meos, primus qui me sibi iunxit, amores abstulit; ille habeat secum seruetque sepulchro.
reuse.text_original: audi, quid ex persona uiduae continentis ethnicus poeta decantet: ille meos, primus qui me sibi iunxit, amores abstulit; ille habeat secum seruetque sepulchro.
reuse.text_english: Listen to what the pagan poet sings in the voice of a chaste widow: he, the first who joined me to himself, has taken my loves away; let him keep them with him and guard them in the tomb.
